scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && npx wrangler d1 export gdgu_idp_db --remote --output backups/gdgu_idp_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql -y
scripts.db:timetravel: npx wrangler d1 time-travel info gdgu_idp_db
scripts.deploy: npm run build:cf && npx wrangler deploy
